facts.text: Complete Run cloud migration setup for Dynamics GP migration before configuring company migration.
GP Company Migration Configuration page opens automatically after Cloud Migration Setup; can open manually from Cloud Migration Management.
Global settings update all companies whose migration is not complete, overriding company-specific settings.
Set dimensions using Set All Dimensions action to assign two segments from GP as global dimensions.
Choose modules to migrate globally; turning off General Ledger automatically disables open purchase orders.
Specify Master Data Only for modules where transactions should not migrate.
Configure Oldest GL Year to select which historical years to migrate; if empty, all years migrate.
Per Company section allows separate configuration when migrating multiple companies.
